knownIssues.summary: Clicking Publish/Unpublish as a caller who is NOT the cycle's direct MyManager (e.g. Director, two levels up) throws an unhandled server exception (HTTP 500 from Service/MgScanService.asmx/SetManagementScanPublishState) instead of a graceful authorization error. STILL PRESENT on 2026-08-12 - unchanged from the 2026-08-10 baseline.
knownIssues.reproduction: Log in as an org-level Director (manager's manager, not the direct MyManager of the candidate), open Nine-Grid, Generate, select the candidate's cell, click Publish/Unpublish on their row.
knownIssues.evidence: Response body: {"Message":"There was an error processing the request.","StackTrace":"","ExceptionType":""} - reproduced independently on three separate test runs now (2026-08-10 x2, 2026-08-12).
knownIssues.suggestedFix: MgScanService.asmx.cs SetManagementScanPublishState already has an UnAuthorized-result check - the underlying ManagementScanPlayBO.SetPublishState call for a non-authorized caller appears to throw before reaching that check rather than returning a normal ManagementScanSaveResult with Errors=["UnAuthorized"]. Not part of any PR merged between the two test dates, so no regression - still open.

knownIssues.area: IT test environment has not picked up the new release yet
knownIssues.summary: master has merged real Management Scan changes since the 2026-08-10 baseline (PR 5665 'Assessment play - change manager question tokens and remove open questions', PR 5661 'Manager report', plus several Manager-view fixes) - but the assessment play flow on this IT environment still rendered 31 questions for the Manager/evaluator side (unchanged from baseline), confirming the deployed build has NOT been updated with these merges yet.
knownIssues.reproduction: Complete the Manager/evaluator side of a fresh assessment cycle and count rendered .mgscan-question elements - expected 28 post-release, observed 31.
knownIssues.suggestedFix: This run should be treated as a same-build repeat of the baseline, not a genuine new-release comparison. Re-run after IT is redeployed, or run once directly against a freshly built master locally, to actually measure the new release.

knownIssues.summary: Unlike Publish, the Kalibirity position-override swatches correctly appear non-actionable for a Director who is not the candidate's direct MyManager (click never completes/times out) - no data mutation is possible, consistent with ADR-001 authorization intent. Confirmed again on 2026-08-12.
knownIssues.reproduction: Log in as Director, open Kalibirity tab, Generate, attempt to click an alternate position swatch on the candidate row.

knownIssues.summary: Clicking 'Add New' on the candidate listing intermittently lands on an unrelated 'My Account' tab (test-assignment grid) instead of opening the new-candidate form. On 2026-08-12 this occurred on the FIRST TWO attempts to create the validation-only account (both timed out fully at 45s rather than recovering via the script's retry loop) before succeeding on the 3rd manual retry - a higher failure rate than baseline's '2 of roughly 6'. Worth a closer look if this is trending worse, though still recoverable by hand.
knownIssues.reproduction: Occurred 2 of 3 attempts creating the validation-only account on 2026-08-12; not deterministic.

knownIssues.summary: Not observed on 2026-08-12 (0 occurrences across Manager and Director runs). Baseline logged one non-reproducible occurrence on 2026-08-10 - still treated as a one-off, not a confirmed bug.

Employee Personal Dashboard's 'Report (PDF)' button took 6,589ms on 2026-08-12, down from 12,768ms at baseline (2026-08-10) - roughly 2x faster. terminologyNote: The Nine-Grid's own "Manager"/"Director" progress bars refer to the two sides of a Management Scan cycle (the assessment SUBJECT is labeled "Manager"; their evaluator/boss is labeled "Director") - NOT the org-hierarchy test account names used in this report's Role column. In this test hierarchy: PerfTest Employee is the assessment subject (feature's "Manager"), PerfTest Manager is the evaluator (feature's "Director"), and PerfTest Director is one level further up, used only for the Nine-Grid roll-up/subtree view.
